scenes.title: Welcome home
scenes.text: An event-specific welcome, fast links, announcements and the next sessions.

scenes.title: Plan the day
scenes.text: Switch days, search the program and save the sessions you want to attend.

scenes.title: Find your people
scenes.text: An opt-in attendee directory with search, networking interests and saved connections.

scenes.title: Keep in touch
scenes.text: Private one-to-one conversations. These example conversations are sample data.

scenes.title: Your sponsor workspace
scenes.text: Sponsors see only their assigned sponsor pages and an entry point to edit each one.

scenes.title: Make a great introduction
scenes.text: Edit the company introduction, logo, booth and call-to-action with an instant attendee-page preview.

scenes.title: Run the event
scenes.text: Event content, agenda, sponsors, registrations and moderation from one organizer console.

scenes.title: The right access for everyone
scenes.text: Add users, choose Admin / Sponsor / Member, and assign the sponsor pages a user can edit.

scenes.title: Ready for the room
scenes.text: Content-readiness checks and recorded verification of real email, messaging, devices and event-network testing.
